text.tspan: After our phone conversation of 6/8/92 I got to thinking about what you had stated on your
experience with developers like Word Perfect Corporation. We had just received a study done by
Cornell University on the number of installed (or shipped) machines we have out there. I thought
that these figures could be of some help to you in this matter, so here is a copy of their findings.
Good luck, and I hope it will help.
